snippet.title: Marvel’s Wolverine - Story Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/marvels-wolverine/

New allies and formidable adversaries emerge in the clash for mutant survival. As Wolverine, unite with Jean Grey to protect those most vulnerable. Fight alongside Team X to confront the world’s deadliest villains in the caliber of Bolivar Trask, Omega Red, and Deathstrike, and stand against oppressive forces like The Reavers and The Hand. 

Marvel’s Wolverine launches September 15, 2026, on PlayStation 5 consoles. Pre-order and wishlist now on the PlayStation Store. For more information, visit https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/marvels-wolverine/

#ps5 #ps5games #wolverine #marvelswolverine
